notes: AMC Networks rebranded as AMC Global Media; it is a programmer/streamer, not a telecom or station owner, so subscription and licence facets are mostly not applicable.

communications_activity.value: Cable television programming networks and streaming services (AMC, BBC America, We TV, AMC+, Acorn TV, Shudder), plus network origination services

network_distribution_assets.value: Technical facility for network origination and satellite delivery; programming distributed through third-party cable, satellite and streaming platforms

coverage_distribution_reach.value: Content made available to audiences everywhere across cable, satellite and streaming distribution

advertising_carriage_economics_broadcast.value: Revenue from advertising on cable networks and affiliate carriage fees from distributors, plus streaming subscriptions and content licensing
